name: renault-mmi
description: RenaultMMI monorepo: CAN decoder, Node services and the Electron infotainment UI

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace services && concurrently -k -n services,app -c blue,green "npm run watch --workspace services" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace services && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace services && npm run test --workspace frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace services && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
